messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday (or a holiday that is observed on a Monday when the statutory holiday falls on a weekend).  The table shows the holiday, the day of the week it fell on, and the three‑day weekend that resulted.

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long Weekend (Days) |
|-------------|---------|-------------|---------------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Monday | Mon‑Tue |
| **Mar 31** | Good Friday | Friday | Fri‑Sat |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | Mon‑Tue |
| **Sep 4**  | Labour Day | Monday | Mon‑Tue |
| **Oct 9**  | Thanksgiving | Monday | Mon‑Tue |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Friday | Fri‑Sat |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | Mon‑Tue |

> **Notes & Provincial Variations**
> 
> * **Family Day** is observed in several provinces (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, and Prince Edward Island) on the third Monday in February.  In 2023 it was on Feb 20.  Provinces that do not observe Family Day (e.g., British Columbia, Quebec, Newfoundland & Labrador) do not get this long weekend.
> * **Good Friday** is a statutory holiday in all provinces and territories, so every Canadian gets the Fri‑Sat long weekend on Mar 31.
> * **Victoria Day** is a federal holiday and is observed nationwide on the Monday preceding May 25, giving a Mon‑Tue long weekend on May 22.
> * **Labour Day** is a federal holiday and is observed nationwide on the first Monday in September, giving a Mon‑Tue long weekend on Sep 4.
> * **Thanksgiving** is a federal holiday and is observed nationwide on the second Monday in October, giving a Mon‑Tue long weekend on Oct 9.
> * **Remembrance Day** is a statutory holiday in all provinces and territories, so every Canadian gets the Fri‑Sat long weekend on Nov 11.
> * **Christmas Day** is a federal holiday and is observed nationwide on December 25, giving a Mon‑Tue long weekend on Dec 25.
> * **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) is a statutory holiday in most provinces, but because it falls on a Tuesday in 2023 it does not create a long weekend.

If you need a more granular breakdown (e.g., which provinces observe which holidays), let me know and I can expand the table accordingly.
